description: This Java class 'ObjectType' provides utility methods for analyzing, converting, and comparing Java object types using reflection, including class loading, instance checks, and type conversions.

classes.name: ObjectType.NullObject
classes.description: A singleton class representing a null object, implementing Serializable, with custom toString, hashCode, and equals methods.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class by name using the current thread's context classloader or a specified classloader, handling primitive types, arrays, and class aliases.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a class by name using its no-argument constructor.

methods.name: instanceOf
methods.description: Checks if a class or object is a subclass or implements an interface, given a class name.

methods.name: loadInfoClass
methods.description: Helper method to load a class by name, trying different package prefixes if necessary.

methods.name: simpleTypeOrObjectConvert
methods.description: Converts an object to a specified type, handling various Java types, including primitives, collections, dates, and strings, with optional formatting, locale, and timezone.

methods.name: doRealCompare
methods.description: Performs comparison operations between two objects of a specified type, supporting operators like equals, less, greater, contains, and handling nulls and collections.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if an object is considered empty, supporting String, Collection, Map, CharSequence, IsEmpty, and other types.
